title: War of Kings → Realm of Kings → The Thanos Imperative
subtitle: The next cosmic sequence after Annihilation and Conquest
intro: This path moves through three connected eras. Optional background and ongoing-series branches are separated from the central miniseries. Start at Road to War of Kings for a shorter route; read the complete War of Kings finale and Who Will Rule? before Realm of Kings. Realm is a one-shot plus parallel series, not a six-issue central event. Finish the Guardians/Nova bridge before Thanos Imperative: Ignition. The core and side-track recipes repeat anchors; repeated collection links mean borrow once. Dates describe original stories, not catalog reprints.

steps.title: Optional backstory: Vulcan and the Inhumans
steps.issues: Uncanny X-Men #475–486; X-Men: Emperor Vulcan #1–5; Silent War #1–6
steps.why: Two background paths explain the rival powers; none is required to read the main war.
steps.match: Three different books: Rise & Fall of the Shi’ar Empire leads into Emperor Vulcan. Silent War is a separate Inhuman background branch. These are complementary stories, not alternative editions.
order: Shi’ar branch: Uncanny X-Men #475–486 → X-Men: Emperor Vulcan #1–5
Inhuman branch: Silent War #1–6 → Secret Invasion: Inhumans #1–4 (in next stage)

steps.title: Optional catch-up: the ongoing heroes and Secret Invasion
steps.issues: Guardians of the Galaxy (2008) #1–12; Nova (2007) #13–22; Secret Invasion: Inhumans #1–4
steps.why: Useful continuity for readers following Richard, the Guardians or the royal family from Conquest.
steps.match: Consecutive Guardians books: Legacy #1–6 then War of Kings Book 1 #7–12. Consecutive Nova books: Secret Invasion #13–18 then Nova Corps #19–22. The Inhumans miniseries is a separate branch. None replaces the War of Kings core.
order: Secret Invasion: Inhumans #1–4 before Secret Invasion: War of Kings

steps.title: Road to War of Kings
steps.issues: Secret Invasion: War of Kings #1; X-Men: Kingbreaker #1–4
steps.why: The immediate political and Starjammer setup. The Saga recap is optional.
steps.match: This trade contains Kingbreaker, Secret Invasion: War of Kings and War of Kings Saga. It is much shorter than the similarly named Prelude Omnibus. Secret Invasion: War of Kings also appears in the main-event book below.
order: Optional War of Kings Saga recap

steps.title: War of Kings and its immediate epilogue
steps.issues: War of Kings #1–6; War of Kings: Who Will Rule? #1
steps.why: The full central war and the transition into its consequences.
steps.match: The exact digital edition contains Secret Invasion: War of Kings, main #1–6 and Who Will Rule? Read the setup one-shot only once if already covered in Road.
order: Secret Invasion: War of Kings #1 (skip if already read)
War of Kings: Who Will Rule? #1

steps.title: Optional war branches: Guardians and Nova
steps.why: Follow the ongoing heroes alongside the central war using this selective interleave.
steps.match: Two complementary tie-in books. The local Guardians book lists #13–19; the Nova book lists #23–28. Some print-edition guides give different endpoints, so these ranges follow the supplied digital records.
order: Nova #23 → War of Kings #1 → Nova #24 → War of Kings #2
Guardians #13–14 → War of Kings #3 → Guardians #15 → Nova #25–26
War of Kings #4–5 → Guardians #16 → War of Kings #6
Guardians #17 → Nova #27–28 → Who Will Rule? → Guardians #18–19

steps.title: Realm of Kings: the one-shot
steps.why: Open the next era after Who Will Rule? This is a single issue, not a numbered main miniseries.
steps.match: The Realm of Kings collection includes the opening one-shot plus the three optional miniseries in the next stage. Read its one-shot first.
order: War of Kings: Who Will Rule? #1

steps.title: Optional Realm of Kings miniseries
steps.issues: Realm of Kings: Inhumans #1–5; Imperial Guard #1–5; Son of Hulk #1–4
steps.why: Parallel viewpoints on the changed cosmic landscape. Each can be read as its own block after the opening one-shot.
steps.match: All three are in the same Realm of Kings book already linked above; no second borrowing is needed. These are side stories rather than mandatory steps between every Guardians or Nova issue.
order: Choose: Inhumans #1–5, Imperial Guard #1–5, and/or Son of Hulk #1–4

steps.title: Recommended bridge: finish Guardians and Nova
steps.why: These ongoing-series finales carry the heroes toward The Thanos Imperative.
steps.match: Two complementary volumes. Nova #29–31 are the preceding bridge; its #32–36 continue into this era. Guardians #25 is included, even though some event checklists stop at #24. Do not jump ahead to later Guardians relaunches.
order: Guardians of the Galaxy (2008) #20–25 and Nova (2007) #32–36 — parallel series blocks

steps.title: The Thanos Imperative: Ignition and the complete main series
steps.issues: The Thanos Imperative: Ignition #1; The Thanos Imperative #1–6
steps.why: The connected cosmic saga reaches its central finale.
steps.match: The exact digital ISBN is independently confirmed to contain Ignition, all six main issues and Devastation. Read Ignition before #1; the catalog’s short “#1–6” title omits the one-shots.

steps.title: Devastation: close the saga
steps.why: A short epilogue after #6, setting up the next cosmic team.
steps.match: Already in the same Thanos Imperative volume. Annihilators (2011) is a later follow-up, not a replacement for this saga’s main event.
